name: todo-txt
title: todo.txt
description: Manage your todo.txt tasks in Raycast, fully in sync with the classic CLI through the shared file system.
author: Prezoza

commands.name: create-new-task
commands.title: Create new task
commands.description: Add a new task to the list, and associate it with projects or contexts.

commands.name: view-tasks
commands.title: Show uncompleted tasks
commands.subtitle: Filter by +project(s), @context(s), or phrase(s)
commands.description: Lists all uncompleted tasks. Search filters are comma seperated. Projects prepended with +, contexts with @. Defaults to matching all filters (logical AND), can be set to matching any filters (logical OR).

preferences.name: todoDir
preferences.title: Todo Folder
preferences.description: The folder where new or existing todo.txt files are.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
